onlyOwner function setting pending newOwner address.

Overrides acceptOwnership; moves all owner balance to newOwner and finalizes ownership.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the contract owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender key when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender provides the burned balance in burn.
msg.sender must satisfy onlyOwner before distributing owner funds.
msg.sender determines which lockup balance is released in unlock.
msg.sender/newOwner identity drives the final ownership acceptance.
block.timestamp (now) is added to LOCKUP_TERM to compute ExpireTime, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp (now) is compared against the stored lockup expiry, creating timestamp dependency.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates burn on msg.sender equality with owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates distribute on msg.sender equality with owner.
onlyNewOwner modifier checks msg.sender != 0 and msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyNewOwner modifier gates the overridden acceptOwnership.
Constructor performs unchecked multiplication initialSupply * 10 ** decimals when minting _totalSupply.
distribute computes ExpireTime = now + LOCKUP_TERM, a timestamp-dependent arithmetic operation.
unlock requires _lockupExpireTime[tokenHolder] <= now, a timestamp-dependent authorization check.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
_to parameter is the credited account in transfer.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transfer.
_holder parameter is queried in balanceOf.
_holder parameter is queried in lockupBalanceOf.
_holder parameter is queried in unlockTimeOf.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount in approve.
_holder parameter is looked up in allowance.
_spender parameter is looked up in allowance.
_value parameter is the amount subtracted from balance and total supply in burn.
_to parameter is the distribution recipient in distribute.
_value parameter is the distributed amount in distribute.
_lockupRate parameter controls the locked/free split in distribute.
burn derives the local burner from msg.sender.
distribute computes the local lockupValue from _value and _lockupRate.
distribute computes the local givenValue as _value - lockupValue.
distribute computes the local ExpireTime from now + LOCKUP_TERM.
unlock derives the local tokenHolder from msg.sender.
unlock reads value from _lockupBalances[tokenHolder].
acceptOwnership caches the owner balance in ownerAmount before transferring it.
